entities.name: Kabra Mecanor Belling Technik Private Limited

industry: Industrials > Capital Goods > Industrial Manufacturing > Industrial Products

operating_notes.text: Heavy rainfall in Daman in July 2026 flooded the Kachigam manufacturing facility; the insurance claim is under evaluation with recovery not yet determined.
Battery Division segment revenue was ₹236.06 Cr for H1FY27 against ₹77.10 Cr in H1FY26, with segment result of ₹12.26 Cr versus a ₹20.40 Cr loss.
Mr. Yogesh Deo, CEO – Extrusion Division, retires effective October 22, 2026; Mr. Mahaboob Ali Khan is appointed CEO – Extrusion Division from October 23, 2026.
Incorporated Geon International FZ-LLC in UAE as a 100% wholly owned subsidiary with an initial subscribed share capital of AED 3.9 Mn.

timeline.summary: On April 27, 2026, Kabra Extrusion Technik announced the resignation of CFO Daulat Jain.

On May 13, 2026, Kabra Extrusion Technik informed the exchange that CRISIL downgraded its long-term bank facilities to CRISIL A-/Stable and short-term facilities to CRISIL A2+ based on Q3 performance.
On May 28, 2026, Kabra Extrusion Technik reported FY26 revenue of ₹451.05 Cr and Q4FY26 revenue of ₹120.14 Cr.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹220.96 Cr (+64.2% YoY), net profit ₹3.97 Cr (+1103.0% YoY).
On October 15, 2026, Kabra Extrusion Technik reported Q2FY27 consolidated revenue of ₹221 Cr, up 64.2% YoY, and a net profit of ₹3.97 Cr.
